scope_statement: This contract is written before any audio leaves the machine. It fixes what the external schema smoke test is allowed to ask, what counts as a present field, what counts as repeatable, and what each possible outcome permits a lane to do in checkpoint 22E4. It measures response shape and repeatability only. It measures no accuracy, selects no system and sets no threshold.
question_under_test: For each external lane and locale configuration, do the response fields that the provider documents actually appear in a real response, and does an identical request return an identical response?
not_under_test: cost or latency at benchmark scale

transmitted_fields: the clip audio as stored in the private benchmark tree
the intended reference text for that clip
never_transmitted_fields: any held out participant or clip

azure_configurations.documented_expectation: en-AU is a supported pronunciation assessment locale, but phoneme name, syllable group and spoken phoneme output are documented for en-US only, so the expected result is a per position phoneme accuracy score with no phoneme name.
en-US with the IPA alphabet is documented to return phoneme names, syllable groups and NBestPhonemes spoken phoneme candidates with confidence scores.

azure_request_policy.endpoint_note: Microsoft documents a custom subdomain form at https://RESOURCE.cognitiveservices.azure.com/stt/speech/recognition/conversation/cognitiveservices/v1. The regional speech host is used instead because the recorded .env endpoint is the regional form and the resource key authenticates against both. The region is australiaeast, which is the recorded processing region for this resource.
azure_request_policy.undocumented_parameter_note: The REST short audio reference lists ReferenceText, GradingSystem, Granularity, Dimension, EnableMiscue, EnableProsodyAssessment and ScenarioId only. PhonemeAlphabet and NBestPhonemeCount are documented for the Speech SDK configuration object. Whether the REST header honours them is an open empirical question this smoke test must answer rather than assume.
azure_request_policy.prosody_note: Prosody assessment is documented as en-US only and is a prohibited output class for this project, so it is never requested.

field_presence_rules.present: the field exists in the parsed response with a non null value on every clip in the configuration
field_presence_rules.partial: the field exists on at least one clip but not on every clip
field_presence_rules.absent: the field exists on no clip
field_presence_rules.unknown_is_absent: any field the runner cannot locate is recorded absent; a missing field is never assumed present

capability_probes.phoneme_name: a phoneme level Phoneme field naming the expected phone
capability_probes.spoken_phoneme_candidates: a phoneme level NBestPhonemes list whose entries carry a Phoneme name and a Score
capability_probes.miscue_error_types: a word level ErrorType able to take the values Omission or Insertion
capability_probes.ipa_alphabet_honoured: phoneme names rendered in IPA rather than SAPI when PhonemeAlphabet is IPA

repeatability_rules.method: each clip is sent twice per configuration with byte identical audio and byte identical assessment parameters
repeatability_rules.exact: every recorded numeric score and every phone name string is identical across both repeats
repeatability_rules.stable_schema_only: the field set is identical across both repeats but at least one numeric value differs
repeatability_rules.unstable: the field set differs across repeats, or a request failed on one repeat and succeeded on the other
repeatability_rules.tolerance_note: no tolerance is granted. A provider whose identical request returns different numbers is recorded as such, because that materially affects how any later comparison must be interpreted.

advancement_rules.exact_relation_capable: the configuration exposes a phoneme name for the expected phone and a named produced or candidate phone with a score. Only such a configuration may supply exact relation evidence in checkpoint 22E4.
advancement_rules.score_only: the configuration exposes a phoneme level score but no named produced phone. It may supply score only concern evidence in checkpoint 22E4 and may never be read as naming what the speaker produced.
advancement_rules.failed: the configuration does not expose a usable phoneme level score, or its requests did not succeed. It advances nothing.
advancement_rules.no_lane_advances_on_marketing: a documented claim, a product page, an overall score or agreement with another system can never qualify a configuration. Only observed response fields can.

prohibited_outputs: any pooling of en-AU and en-US results
any treatment of an Azure score as reference truth or as Australian truth
any use of en-US produced phones for vowel, diphthong or post vocalic r relations

failure_handling.on_http_error: record the status code, the response body classification and the configuration outcome as failed; do not retry more than twice and never vary the request to obtain a better answer
failure_handling.on_quota_error: record it and stop; report to Adam rather than hammering retries
failure_handling.partial_run_is_reported: a configuration that could not be completed is reported incomplete rather than omitted

privacy_and_storage.raw_responses: retained privately under .research_data and never committed
privacy_and_storage.committed_report: aggregate field presence, repeatability and outcome only, with no transcript text, no per clip score and no participant identifier
privacy_and_storage.secrets: credentials are read from the gitignored .env by variable name and never printed, logged or written to any artifact

release_lock: Completing this contract unlocks nothing. No task, prompt pack, extractor, candidate artifact, score, coaching output, progress metric, screening or diagnosis is created or approved by a schema smoke test.
